data.description: Elegant Waterfront Living at Soulever by Omniyat, Dubai Maritime City
data.display_address: Soulever by Beyond, Maritime City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Soulever by Omniyat redefines luxury with its harmonious design inspired by Dubai’s maritime heritage. Set in the heart of Dubai Maritime City, this stunning development features two towers connected by lush landscapes and water-inspired architecture.

Each residence is a private retreat, blending natural textures with warm, minimalist interiors. The expansive terraces, floor-to-ceiling windows, and thoughtful spatial design invite sunlight and sea breeze into every corner, offering uninterrupted views of the Dubai skyline, the Forest, and the Cove.

Residents enjoy access to a world-class collection of amenities, a state-of-the-art gym, yoga areas, outdoor exercise zones, a dedicated spa, and elegant lounges designed for social gatherings or quiet reflection. Soulever is more than a home — it’s a lifestyle that embodies the essence of waterfront tranquility.
